title: Museum Siam
description: museumsiam.org Museum Siam museum in Bangkok run by NDMI under the public organization OKMD — the .org domain is real, but it's a government institute, not a private company. It occupies the former Ministry of Commerce building (1921–1922) and opened as a museum on 2 April 2008. The core exhibit Decoding Thainess (14 rooms on how Thai identity was formed) has run since 2017; there's also a free Underground Museum at MRT Sanam Chai (2020). Attendance is ~250–343K per year (different counting methods), 3.8M over 17 years; museum-level revenue isn't disclosed — finances publish only at OKMD level. Tickets: 100 THB adult, 50 students, free for kids under 15, 60+, monks, disabled visitors; open Tue–Sun 10:00–18:00. Beyond exhibits: a 4,000+ resource library, digital archives, venue rental (5–80K THB), and a nationwide museum-network support program.
